verdict.rationale: Pipedream documents an MCP client library that auto-loads all available tools (mcpClient.tools()) and a REST API/SDKs for Connect, plus per-app dedicated MCP servers listing tools (e.g. openai.md showing 46 actions/4 triggers), which supports programmatic tool discovery. However, there's no explicit documented registry/catalog search API (e.g., a dedicated endpoint to query across the 3,000+ apps/10,000+ tools catalog by keyword or category) distinct from per-app MCP servers or the SDK's tools() call. missing for 10: a documented cross-catalog registry search/query endpoint, independent evidence of agents using this discovery API in production, and clarity on catalog metadata (versioning, categories) beyond per-app tool lists.
